output.title: New `ciss` short name for ClusterIssuer arrives with cert-manager upgrade
output.content: The environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 (Flux HelmRelease, Argo CD Application, helmfile and Helm annotation sources), so upgrading to v1.18.0 brings this change: ClusterIssuer gets the new `ciss` short name. The release notes list it only as a feature and say nothing about breaking behaviour. Only certificates.cert-manager.io [v1] appears among installed CRDs, the crds dimension is marked absent, and no ClusterIssuer manifest appears among the apiVersions in use (only cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate). The operator should check whether the ClusterIssuer CRD is installed and how CRDs get updated during the upgrade, so they know whether `ciss` will actually show up in the cluster.
